## E. Defect route (frozen rule `route_d`)

Label: **D_NO_MATERIAL_DEFECT**. Examined claims:

- `SHRUNK_ROUTING_TABLES` (nrm/fa/prc.py set_tables / route): along the tilt line of the final refreshed book at strength 8 the routing dependence score and the exact dependence term are anti-ranked (Spearman -0.995 / -0.996, PRC; audit). Rule label: `NOT_A_DEFECT_DOCUMENTED_APPROXIMATION`.
- `CELL_MEAN_CODEWORD_REFRESH` (nrm/fa/prc.py update_book): on the real chains the refresh never raised the objective (largest refresh change -9.1e-7 / -7.1e-7); in law B stale codewords raised the objective without changing the release (investigator). Rule label: `NOT_A_DEFECT_DOCUMENTED_APPROXIMATION`.
- `B1_EMISSION_DIFFERS_FROM_SEARCH_PROTOTYPES` (frc/fa/route.py tables): largest |B1 table - prototype| 0.0095 / 0.0066 (PRC_S2), 0.032 / 0.054 (HQ_S2); emitted training cross-entropy <= prototype cross-entropy (audit). Rule label: `NOT_A_DEFECT_DOCUMENTED_APPROXIMATION`.
- `SEVEN_TILT_FIRST_IMPROVEMENT_SEARCH` (nrm/fa/prc.py lloyd): improving tilt windows without a power of two are never tried (laws D and E; version 1 at strength 8 on the real statistics, window near t = 0.19 between the tried 0.125 and 0.25). Rule label: `NOT_A_DEFECT_DOCUMENTED_APPROXIMATION`.
